lines.text: 回北京之前，周经理做的第一件事就是打开手机：“回去的票，我们跟小雨买同一趟。”
lines.py: huí Běi jīng zhī qián, Zhōu jīng lǐ zuò de dì yī jiàn shì jiù shì dǎ kāi shǒu jī: “huí qù de piào, wǒ men gēn Xiǎo yǔ mǎi tóng yí tàng.”
lines.en: Before heading back to Beijing, the first thing Manager Zhou does is open her phone. "For the trip home, we're getting the same train as Xiaoyu."
